notes.title: The commons
notes.science: A shared store lasts while each one takes a little. When each takes a little more, it can run out for everyone.
notes.limits: One mushroom and one rule for taking make a toy commons.
notes.counter: Elinor Ostrom found many real groups that keep a commons for centuries with rules of their own, and no owner.
notes.question: Who took too much when everyone was hungry?

sources.label: The Tragedy of the Commons, Hardin, 1968

notes.title: Giving when it costs
notes.science: A gift that costs the giver more says more. A berry in winter tells the other creature something a berry in summer cannot.
notes.limits: Here a winter gift takes more from the giver's store. Nothing else about the giver changes.
notes.counter: A small kindness given often can mean as much as one costly gift.
notes.question: Would you share with someone who once kept from you?

sources.label: Mate Selection: A Selection for a Handicap, Zahavi, 1975
Signaling Theory, Strategic Interaction, and Symbolic Capital, Bliege Bird and Smith, 2005

moss: I have seen a great many winters. The mushroom fed us through all of them, in the years when nobody took too much.
